DAY IN LIFE - CIRCULAR ECONOMY

Complete 6-Step Process from Seller to Recycler to Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

Our transparent, traceable network connects everyone in the scrap recycling chain, creating a true circular economy where nothing goes to waste.

01

Business / Individual Seller Initiates

Use Scraplo Connect app to select scrap categories and schedule pickup

Choose from metal, paper/cardboard, plastic, or mixed waste. Get live pricing per kg.

02

Connect to Pickup Partner - Weighing & Payment

GPS-enabled matching with nearest certified pickup agent; standard scale weighing with instant payment to seller

App connects you to trained pickup partner with real-time tracking. Scrap weighed in front of you, payment processed through app immediately.

03

Hub Processing

Scrap transported to hub for segregation and warehousing

Hub partners segregate materials and prepare for recycling

04

Connect to Recycler

Hub connects with certified recycling partners

Materials sent to certified recyclers for processing

05

Online Marketplace for Recycler

Recyclers sell processed end products to buyers, aggregators, and manufacturers

Central marketplace where verified buyers can browse and purchase recycled materials from certified recyclers.

06

Brands / Manufacturers / Importers requiring Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

EPR tracking, accounting and certification for regulatory compliance

Platform facilitates EPR compliance as per CPCB norms, linking physical waste flow to verified credits and filings.

Materials are recycled into new products, completing the cycle—reducing waste and environmental impact while enabling a true circular economy.
